item.title: Core Keeper Gear Progression Guide — Copper to Solarite Armor and Weapon Tiers
item.description: Gear in Core Keeper follows the same ring-biome ore ladder as mining: copper → tin/bronze → iron → scarlet → octarine → galaxite → solarite. This gear progression guide maps each tier to its armor set, the weapon worth crafting, and the accessory slots that actually move your build — so you stop wasting bars on upgrades you’ll wear for ten minutes. Armor sets by tier Every armor piece breaks down the same way: a helm, a chest and pants, each with its own durability.
